overview.description: The Neuberger Total Return Bond ETF (NBTR) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad credit fixed income. The fund is actively managed to invest in a diversified portfolio of USD-denominated bonds of different credit qualities and maturities. The fund aims for total return consistent with capital preservation NBTR was launched on Dec 17, 2024 and is issued by Neuberger Berman.
